Finnish FM @elinavaltonen: “I don't think the US is going anywhere, but, to be quite honest, I think the role of the United States in this entire conflict should be to take the side of the victim and to take the side of freedom and world peace, and that certainly would require increased support for Ukraine rather than being a neutral mediator mediator in the middle.”
